items.raw_excerpt: The inaugural Taiwan Exercise Recovery Technique Open will be held in Taoyuan this Saturday and Sunday, bringing together 95 practitioners from Taiwan and elsewhere in Asia, organizers said Monday.
items.summary_en: The inaugural Taiwan Exercise Recovery Technique Open will be held in Taoyuan this weekend. It brings together 95 practitioners from Taiwan and across Asia.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu will reimburse costs for three LPG cylinders annually from Pongal 2027, benefiting over 1.3 million families.
items.summary_en: The Tamil Nadu government will reimburse the cost of three LPG cylinders per year starting from Pongal 2027. This benefit will help over 1.3 million families in the state. Chief Minister Vijay announced this initiative to support households with cooking fuel expenses.
items.summary_ko: 타밀나두 주 정부는 2027년 평갈부터 매년 가정용 LPG 3개 비용을 보상할 예정입니다. 이 혜택은 주 내 130만 가구 이상에 도움이 될 것입니다. 비제이 주지사는 가정의 조리비 부담을 줄이기 위한 이 사업을 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Tamil Nadu to reimburse cost of three LPG cylinders annually from Pongal 2027
items.title_ko: 타밀나두, 2027년 평갈부터 가정용 LPG 3개 연간 보상 시작
items.title_original: Tamil Nadu government to reimburse cost of three LPG cylinders annually from Pongal 2027: CM Vijay

items.raw_excerpt: A Dunedin councillor wants the public to get involved in changes to the city's alcohol laws, saying proposed changes do not go far enough.
items.summary_en: A Dunedin city councillor says proposed new rules for alcohol licences do not go far enough. The councillor is calling on the public to get involved in the changes to the city's alcohol laws.
items.summary_ko: 더니든 시의원이 주류 면허에 대한 새 규칙이 충분하지 않다고 비판하며 시민들의 참여를 촉구하고 있다.
items.title_en: Dunedin councillor wants stronger changes to alcohol licence rules

items.title_original: New rules for the Dunedin's alcohol licences don't go far enough - councillor

items.raw_excerpt: The complaints involved products including water dispensers, water purifiers and laundry drying racks.
items.summary_en: Singapore consumer group CASE is helping customers get refunds from a company called Nereos. Forty-seven people complained about water dispensers, purifiers, and drying racks they paid for but never received.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 소비자보호단체 CASE가 Nereos 고객들의 환불을 돕고 있다. 정수기, 물병 dispensers, 빨래건조대 등 47건의 제품 미배송 불만이 접수됐다.
items.title_en: Singapore consumers seek refunds after 47 complaints about undelivered home products
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 소비자단체, 배송 미완료 제품 환불 돕다
items.title_original: CASE assists Nereos customers seeking refunds after 47 complaints over unfulfilled orders

items.raw_excerpt: The new measures move us toward treating child-raising as something to build and maintain collectively as a society, says Kalpana Vignehsa from the Institute of Policy Studies.
items.summary_en: New government measures aim to make child-raising a collective responsibility. An expert from the Institute of Policy Studies says the real change goes beyond the S$70,000 baby bonus per child. The policies move Singapore toward treating parenting as something society builds together.
items.summary_ko: 새 정부 지원책은 육아를 사회가 공동으로 책임져야 할 일로 만드는 데 초점을 맞추고 있다. 정책연구소의 칼파나 비네흐사 전문가는 이번 변화의 핵심이 아이당 7만 싱가포르 달러 지원금 그 너머에 있다고 강조했다. 이번 조치는 육아를 공동의 노력으로 바라보는 싱가포르의 전환을 보여 준다.
items.title_en: Singapore policy shifts toward raising children as a shared society effort
items.title_ko: 싱가포르, 육아를 사회 전체가 함께 책임지는 방향으로 정책 전환
items.title_original: Snap Insight: NDR 2026 - the real shift in family support goes beyond S$70,000 per child

items.raw_excerpt: Up to 80,000 fans will party at the Creamfields festival in Cheshire in late August.
items.summary_en: Up to 80,000 fans are expected at the Creamfields music festival in Cheshire in late August. Neighbours living near the festival site say the noise and crowds make them feel like prisoners in their own homes.
items.summary_ko: 8월 말에 체셔에서 열리는 크림필드 음악 페스티벌에 최대 8만 명이 방문할 예정이다. 페스티벌 장소 근처에 사는 주민들은 소음과 인파 때문에 집 안에 갇힌 기분이라고 말한다.
items.title_en: Neighbours of Creamfields Festival say they feel trapped at home
items.title_ko: 크림필드 페스티벌 인근 주민들, 집 안에 갇힌 느낌이라 호소
items.title_original: Festival's neighbours 'feel like prisoners in our own homes'

items.raw_excerpt: La France compte plus de 35 000 communes, dont une majorité de petites localités rurales. Parmi elles, certaines se distinguent par une population quasi inexistante.
items.summary_en: France has more than 35,000 communes, and most are small rural towns. Some of these places have almost no people living in them at all. A new look at these tiny towns shows just how quiet some corners of France really are.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에는 35,000개가 넘는 코뮌이 있으며, 대부분 소규모 농촌 마을이다. 이 중 일부는 사실상 주민이 거의 없는 곳도 있다. 프랑스의 가장 조용한 구석구석을 돌아보는 기사이다.
items.title_original: Ces villes qui comptent le moins d'habitants en France - Planet.fr

items.raw_excerpt: Phase two will start now - including some affordable - after all phase one houses were snapped up
items.summary_en: A new phase of 70 homes is being built in Goonhavern, Cornwall. All houses in the first phase were sold quickly. The second phase will include some affordable homes.
items.summary_ko: 콘월의 군하번에서 70가구 규모 주택 2단계 사업이 시작됐다. 1단계는 모두 빠르게 팔렸다. 2단계에는 일부 보급형 주택이 포함된다.
items.title_en: Second phase of housing project starts in Goonhavern
items.title_original: Second phase of 70 homes scheme underway in Goonhavern - Cornwall Live

items.raw_excerpt: On Friday August 28th, another eclipse will take place in the skies above Spain. This time it will be a partial lunar eclipse.
items.summary_en: A partial lunar eclipse will appear in the skies over Spain on Friday, August 28th. People across the country can watch it without any special equipment. The eclipse will be visible for several hours as the Earth's shadow covers part of the Moon.
items.summary_ko: 8월 28일 금요일 스페인 하늘에서 부분 월식이 일어납니다. 특별한 장비 없이 전국에서 관찰할 수 있으며, 지구 그림자가 달 일부를 가리는 모습을 수 시간 동안 볼 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: What to Know About This Week's Partial Lunar Eclipse in Spain

items.title_original: What to know about this week's partial lunar eclipse in Spain
